mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (all else equal) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds continuously without threshold activation.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.2% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls below 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales (both above their 3-month moving averages) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative 20-day forward returns due to increased discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises for 3 consecutive months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 1200.0 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity, which boosts related sectors and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200.0 thousand units over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in industrial production and GDP growth (both above their 3-month averages) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 are above their 3-month averages over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (CPIAUCSL above 2.5% annualized), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to the risk of monetary policy tightening and reduced corporate profit margins.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% annualized over a 3-year rolling window.
